title: Change the contact details on a recreational fishing licence
summary: Update your address, email address, and/or contact number for a recreational fishing licence online.
intro:
If you need to update your address, email address and/or contact number on a 1-year or 3-year recreational fishing licence, you can do this online, as long as your current email address or mobile phone number is recorded with NSW Primary Industries.

Note: If you need to update the name on a recreational fishing licence, go to Change the name on a recreational fishing licence and follow the instructions.
who_can_apply: Must have a 1-year or 3-year recreational fishing licence.
Must have a current email address or mobile phone number recorded with NSW Primary Industries.

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to update your contact details.

internal_links.text: Change the name on a recreational fishing licence

faqs.q: Can I update my contact details online?
faqs.a: Yes, you can update your address, email address, and/or contact number for a 1-year or 3-year recreational fishing licence online.

faqs.q: What must I have to update my contact details?
faqs.a: You need your name, licence number, and your new contact details.

faqs.q: What if I need to update my name on my licence?
faqs.a: If you need to update the name on a recreational fishing licence, you must go to Change the name on a recreational fishing licence.
